steps.title: 17. The raw response

steps.description:
A Cova Member is the anchor for one person on the scheme. You rarely type one by hand — it is created for you by Clinic › Register to Cova on the Employee, or by the COVA block on a Job Offer for a candidate.

Where you go next: Status tells you whether COVA accepted the registration. Once it reads Active, the reference fields lower down start filling themselves in — Last Visit, Visit, Test Request and Test Result each link to the newest record of that kind, so this form becomes the one place to see everything that has happened to that member.

Fill the fields marked required and press Save (Ctrl+S). The onboarding step ticks itself off as soon as the record exists.
steps.label: COVA Raw
steps.title: 18. Where the membership goes next
